# --- Per-file scoping regressions inside Concrete.toml projects ---
# These exercise compileAndCheck/compileAndReport's project-mode
# routing: invoking on a sibling/nested file must scope the report to
# that file (count of functions checked) without leaking into registry
# validation (no spurious "unknown function" for sibling-file entries).
script:always.34.1
# --- Project-level tests (require Concrete.toml + std) ---
# Auto-discovers every tests/programs/<proj>/ with a Concrete.toml (build+run).
# Bug-regression projects run here (referenced by name for audit_bug_corpus.sh):
#   submodule_linear_consume/src/main  (bug 022 — submodule impl-offset)
#   scand_aggregate_in_scope/src/main  (bug 023 — short-circuit aggregate phi)
#   regress_050_generic_f_std_io/src/main  (bug 050 — a generic named `f` no
#     longer hijacks std.io's local fn-pointer of the same name; pre-fix ANY
#     project defining one was unbuildable as soon as it touched std.io)
#   regress_047_048_hashmap_probe/src/main.con  (bugs 047+048 — overwrite past a
#     tombstone must not duplicate a key, and a missing-key lookup with zero
#     empty slots must return instead of wrapping forever)
#   regress_057_hashmap_by_value/src/main.con  (bug 057 — a HashMap passed BY
#     VALUE must arrive whole: hash_fn for get (SIGSEGV pre-fix), cap for drop)
#   regress_082_project_alias_binding/src/main.con  (bugs 082+055 — a sibling
#     submodule alias builds, and std.math.abs is not hijacked by a sibling's abs)
#   regress_087_borrow_shadow_uaf/src/main.con  (bug 087 — an `if` body's
#     `let r` shadowing a borrow-block ref must not outlive the `if`; pre-fix
#     the later `r` read the inner, dropped String: a heap use-after-free)
#   regress_179_concurrent_build/src/main.con  (bug 179 — also built concurrently
#     in the bug 102/105/175 block; pre-fix the builds shared src/main.con.ll)
#   regress_202_project_let_else/src/main.con  (bug 202 — a project's `let … else`
#     reached Check undesugared and was refused; desugaring is part of resolve now)
# The watchdog is lib/bounded.sh (python3, present in the devshell and on CI). Without
# python3 it degrades to running without a watchdog rather than skipping the fixtures,
# and says so once, so a hang on such a machine is at least explicable.
# (lib/bounded.sh is sourced once, right after SUITE_TMPDIR is set, so every section can use it.)
script:always.34.2
